name: hour
description: Hour of day on the reference clock (assumed date base).

name: day_of_week
description: Day of week on the reference calendar.

name: is_weekend
description: Weekend on the REFERENCE calendar (assumption, not local time).

name: day_index
description: Day number since the reference date.

name: is_low_volume_window
description: Hour falls in the 6 consecutive hours with the lowest fit volume.

name: local_hour_est
description: Estimated local hour, assuming the low-volume window is local 00-06.

name: is_business_hours
description: Estimated local business hours on a weekday.

name: is_holiday
description: US federal holiday (New Year, MLK, Presidents, Memorial, Christmas).
model_input_note: US federal holiday days show no volume difference (daily volume ratio 1.00 in fit)

name: holiday_season
formula: learned season start <= date <= end (fit volume ratio block)
description: Year-end volume season learned from fit daily volume (K-10).

name: days_to_nearest_holiday
description: Absolute days to the nearest listed holiday.
model_input_note: derived from the same holiday list as is_holiday (K-10)

name: is_first_seen
description: Entity has no earlier transaction (history features use safe defaults).

name: ent_txn_count
formula: count of earlier txns of entity
description: Past transaction count of the approximate card group (card1+addr1).

name: ent_avg_amt
description: Past mean amount; fit global mean when no history.

name: ent_std_amt
description: Past amount std; fit global std when fewer than 2 past txns.

name: ent_max_amt
description: Past max amount; 0 when no history.

name: amt_ratio_to_ent_avg
description: Amount relative to the entity's past mean; 1 when no history.

name: amt_zscore_ent
description: Amount z-score against entity history; 0 with fewer than 2 past txns.

name: ent_age_days
description: Days since the entity's first transaction; 0 when first seen.

name: ent_unique_device
description: Distinct devices seen earlier for the entity.

name: ent_unique_email
description: Distinct purchaser email domains seen earlier.

name: time_since_last_txn
description: Seconds since the entity's previous transaction; -1 when first seen.

name: avg_inter_arrival
description: Mean past inter-arrival seconds; -1 with fewer than 2 past txns.

name: small_amt_streak_1h
formula: past txns in 1h with amt <= fit small-amount quantile
description: Card-testing signal: earlier small-amount txns in the last 1h.

name: card_age_days
description: Card age: days since first use (D1 interpretation, K-05).

name: is_new_card
description: New card flag.

name: card_start_day
description: D1n: card start day.

name: card_new_addr
description: Known card1 used with a new addr1 (new entity of an old card).

name: device_ent_match
formula: earlier txns of entity with same DeviceInfo
description: How often this device was used by the entity before; 0 when device missing.

name: has_recipient
description: Recipient email present (structural missingness, not an error).

name: email_mismatch
description: Purchaser/recipient email domains differ; 0 unless both are present.

name: foreign_addr2
description: Billing country differs from the most frequent fit value (foreign proxy).

name: addr2_missing
description: addr2 missing (separate flag, also linked to 3-decimal amounts).

name: os_browser_rare
description: Rare or unseen OS/browser combination (only when id_30/id_31 present).

name: amt_log
description: Log amount.

name: amt_n_decimals
description: Number of decimals; 3 = possible currency conversion (community reading).

name: amt_has_3dec
description: Three-decimal amount flag.

name: amt_fit_freq
formula: share of fit rows with the same cent amount
description: How common the exact amount is in the fit set; 0 if unseen.

name: amt_is_common
description: Fixed-price style amount (59, 117, ...).

name: amt_vs_product_q
formula: ECDF of fit amounts within ProductCD
description: Amount percentile within the ProductCD.

name: amt_dev_card4_card6
description: Log-amount deviation within card4+card6.

name: amt_dev_addr1
description: Log-amount deviation within the addr1 region (global stats for small groups).

name: has_identity
description: Identity record present.

name: dist1_missing
description: dist1 missing.

name: dist2_missing
description: dist2 missing.

name: dist1_log
description: Distance signal 1 (NaN kept).

name: dist2_log
description: Distance signal 2 (NaN kept).

name: ent_cnt_1h
description: Past transaction count in the last 1h (velocity).

name: ent_cnt_6h
description: Past transaction count in the last 6h (velocity).

name: ent_cnt_24h
description: Past transaction count in the last 24h (velocity).

name: ent_cnt_7d
description: Past transaction count in the last 7d (velocity).

name: ent_sum_1h
formula: sum of earlier amounts in last 1h
description: Past amount total in the last 1h (velocity).

name: ent_sum_6h
formula: sum of earlier amounts in last 6h
description: Past amount total in the last 6h (velocity).

name: ent_sum_24h
formula: sum of earlier amounts in last 24h
description: Past amount total in the last 24h (velocity).

name: ent_sum_7d
formula: sum of earlier amounts in last 7d
description: Past amount total in the last 7d (velocity).
